title: Xint discloses NGINX2Root chain from nginx to host root
summary: Xint has publicly disclosed NGINX2Root, a claimed chain of five nginx vulnerabilities plus a Linux kernel flaw that takes an nginx visitor to host root. The main flaw, CVE-2026-123007, is described as an unauthenticated HTTP/2 flow-control memory-corruption bug that allows command execution in an nginx worker. The disclosure says nginx 1.30.7 and 1.31.9 fixed 10 CVEs on Nov 18, that Rapid7 has released a PoC, and that no in-the-wild exploitation is known; operators who cannot upgrade should disable external HTTP/2. Because the item is a terse Telegram post rather than a primary advisory, the CVE identifier and fix details are not independently confirmed.
